claims.statement: DocumentationBuilder.copy_extensions defines 22 supported file types including .mdx, .md, .json, .svg, images (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif), video (.mp4, .webm), fonts (.woff2, .woff, .ttf), components (.jsx, .tsx), .txt, and config files (.yml, .yaml, .js, .css, .html). Files not in this set are silently skipped during build operations.

OSS files under oss/ are built for both Python and JavaScript versions: oss/index.mdx produces oss/python/index.mdx and oss/javascript/index.mdx. Each version receives preprocessing with its target language for conditional block filtering and language-specific link rewriting.

Two OSS products are built once without language duplication: Deep Agents Code (oss/deepagents/code/) and OpenWiki (oss/openwiki/). Detection is via is_unversioned_oss_file(), which checks path parts. Both use 'python' as target language for conditional block processing but /oss/deepagents/code/ and /oss/openwiki/ links remain unprefixed.

Managed Deep Agents pages (langsmith/managed-deep-agents*.mdx) emit language-specific routes only: langsmith/python/managed-deep-agents-*.mdx and langsmith/javascript/managed-deep-agents-*.mdx. No unversioned langsmith/managed-deep-agents-*.mdx is created; docs.json redirects handle the unversioned URLs.

_rewrite_oss_links() transforms /oss/ links to language-prefixed form: /oss/langgraph/ becomes /oss/python/langgraph/ or /oss/javascript/langgraph/ per target_language. Already-prefixed links (/oss/python/...), image paths (/oss/images/...), and unversioned product paths (/oss/deepagents/code/, /oss/openwiki/) are left unchanged to prevent double-prefixing and respect special cases.

_rewrite_managed_deep_agents_links() inserts target language into /langsmith/managed-deep-agents paths: /langsmith/managed-deep-agents-quickstart with target_language='python' becomes /langsmith/python/managed-deep-agents-quickstart. Already-prefixed links are preserved unchanged.

_rewrite_snippet_imports_for_language() points MDX imports to language-specific snippet copies: from '/snippets/shared-block.mdx' becomes from '/snippets/python/shared-block.mdx' or from '/snippets/javascript/shared-block.mdx' per target language. Already-prefixed imports are left unchanged.

Shared snippets are emitted in three forms: a default path (snippets/example.mdx) with Python-prefixed absolute links for unversioned importers, a Python copy (snippets/python/example.mdx), and a JavaScript copy (snippets/javascript/example.mdx). The default allows unversioned pages like LangSmith to import without specifying language.

is_shared_file() identifies files not duplicated per language: docs.json, root pages (index.mdx, use-these-docs.mdx, playground.mdx, build-overview.mdx), entire snippets/ directory, images/, .well-known/, fonts/, and .js/.css files. These appear once in the build output, not under oss/python/ or oss/javascript/.

Markdown files (.md, .mdx) are preprocessed via _process_markdown_file(): content is read, preprocess_markdown() applies cross-reference resolution and conditional block filtering per target_language, links are rewritten, an 'Edit Source' GitHub link is appended (except for root index.mdx and snippets), and .md is converted to .mdx. Processing errors are logged and re-raised.

Files named docs.yml are converted to docs.json during the build via _convert_yaml_to_json(): YAML is parsed with yaml.safe_load, converted to JSON with indent=2, and parse or I/O errors are logged and re-raised.

_safe_source_files() rejects symlinks even when they target regular files to prevent host-path exfiltration (e.g., /proc/self/environ). Symlinks are logged as warnings and excluded from the file collection. Resolved paths must stay within the specified root or they are also rejected.

_generate_llms_txt() produces a custom index to override Mintlify's 100,000-character truncation. It indexes all .mdx files, extracts frontmatter (title, description), excludes noindex pages and snippets, and splits large sections into indexed sub-files at <section>/llms.txt. Root file delegates to section indexes via markdown links.

_openapi_entries() derives pages from OpenAPI specs referenced in docs.json by walking the navigation tree, finding all openapi blocks, reading each spec, and generating slug entries. For each operation: it generates <directory>/<tag>/<summary> slug, handles duplicate summaries with numeric suffixes, and skips hidden operations (x-hidden: true).

_generate_llms_full_txt() produces a complete-text corpus by collecting all .mdx pages (excluding snippets and noindex), reading and inlining snippet imports so agents see full content, and splitting language variants into separate files (oss/python/llms-full.txt and oss/javascript/llms-full.txt). Root file opens with site title and links to language splits.

_copy_npm_snippets() copies pre-built React components from @langchain/docs-sandbox npm package, overwriting source-tree versions to always use the latest published. It maps npm filenames to build paths: PatternEmbed.jsx → build/snippets/pattern-embed.jsx, ExampleEmbed.jsx → build/snippets/example-embed.jsx, ChatLangChainEmbed.js → build/ChatLangChainEmbed.js.

The file_system(files: list[File]) context manager from tests/unit_tests/utils.py creates isolated test environments: it creates a temp directory with src/ and build/ subdirectories, populates src/ with File TypedDicts (each with path and either content or bytes), provides list_build_files() and build_file_exists() methods, and cleans up automatically on exit.

_slugify() converts text to URL-safe slugs (lowercase, hyphenate, strip) and drops apostrophes to match Mintlify behavior. _tag_slug() slugs OpenAPI tags while preserving underscores (unlike _slugify) because LangSmith spec carries both annotation-queues and annotation_queues as distinct tags requiring different URLs.

DocumentationBuilder provides three build entry points: build_all() clears the build directory and runs the full pipeline (versioned OSS, unversioned products, shared files, npm snippets, llms.txt generation); build_file(path) builds one file with version-aware routing (OSS files split per language, others build once); build_files(paths) builds multiple files showing a progress bar (hidden in CI).

_validate_llms_indexes() raises ValueError when generated llms.txt indexes exceed the 50,000-character threshold, link to missing section indexes, nest .txt links beyond one level, list pages more than once, or do not cover the expected number of pages.
DocsFileHandler ignores backup names ending in ~, .bak, or .orig and hidden temporary names ending in .tmp, .temp, or .swp, preventing editor artifacts from being queued for rebuilds.

FileWatcher debounces queued source changes for 0.2 seconds, deduplicates them in pending_files, builds a single file or a bounded concurrent batch in worker threads, and then touches routed output artifacts to trigger hot reload.
build_command() returns 1 when the source directory does not exist; otherwise it creates the build directory, invokes DocumentationBuilder.build_all(), and returns 0.

_resolve_within() confines OpenAPI spec reads, llms section-index writes, and snippet imports used for llms-full.txt to their intended build-tree roots. An escaping candidate returns None, so a traversal from editable MDX or docs.json is not read or written outside the build tree.

On deletion, DocsFileHandler removes only the source-relative build path; it does not apply DocumentationBuilder's language routing, so derived versioned artifacts can remain until a full build clears them.
